tasks.title: Document the project and prepare the harness
tasks.acceptance: Documentation and traceability are valid; checks report failures honestly.

tasks.title: Restore client checks
tasks.acceptance: The local CLI starts Metro without the global CLI or @types/react-native; dependency compatibility and limitations are recorded; verify has no errors; warnings are reviewed and a proportionate test strategy is documented.

tasks.title: Upgrade Expo to SDK 57 and prepare local iPhone testing
tasks.acceptance: SDK 57 dependencies and lockfile agree; verify and regression tests pass; iOS/web bundles compile; local LAN launcher is verified without remote changes. Device acceptance remains T04.

tasks.title: Reconcile profiles, courts and membership data
tasks.acceptance: An identified development schema is inspected; migrations/types/queries agree; a disposable backend and verified court catalog can be reproduced.

tasks.title: Protect privileges, the court catalog and membership ownership
tasks.acceptance: Direct requests as A, B and anonymous prove allowed/denied operations, including global-role edits, catalog writes and another user's memberships.

tasks.title: Complete registration, minimal profile and persistent sessions
tasks.acceptance: Registration with/without an immediate session, completed onboarding, restart, refresh and revocation are verified. Pending consent persists for the matching backend/account, retries after failure without a second signup and is cleared only after a successful write.

tasks.title: Isolate personal data and My Courts between accounts
tasks.acceptance: A -> logout -> B never displays A's private data as B's profile, personal court list or local notifications; late responses and notification hydration cannot cross identities.

tasks.title: Validate native maps and connect court discovery
tasks.acceptance: A compatible native map renders real catalog markers and details; map/list agree; permission denial, empty/error states and manual browsing are verified on the chosen platform.

tasks.title: Implement court community membership and My Courts
tasks.acceptance: Join/leave/rejoin and restart preserve the intended state without duplicates; no team is required; no automatic expiry; server rejects identity spoofing and invalid courts.

tasks.title: Verify the complete court-community MVP
tasks.acceptance: A01-A10 have evidence on a confirmed platform with two accounts; errors are recoverable and no simulated events or unfinished controls are presented as working features.
